hero.title: Our Ministries
hero.description: Faith in action. Discover the many ways we are serving our community, supporting one another, and sharing God's love.

ministries.title: Food Pantry
ministries.description: No one in our community should go hungry. Our food pantry provides fresh groceries, non-perishables, and household essentials to families in need every Saturday morning.

ministries.title: Ramp Building
ministries.description: We partner with local organizations to design and construct free, safe wheelchair ramps for the elderly and disabled in our community, restoring their freedom and mobility.

ministries.title: Veterans Ministry
ministries.description: A dedicated community of veterans supporting veterans. We provide a space for fellowship, prayer, PTSD resources, and practical assistance for those who have served our country.

ministries.title: Ministerio Hispano
ministries.description: Buscando a Dios juntos. We offer Spanish-language worship services, translated materials, bilingual Bible studies, and dedicated community support for our Spanish-speaking brothers and sisters.

ministries.title: Homebound & Shut-Ins
ministries.description: Bringing the church to those who cannot attend. Our visitation team provides regular home and hospital visits, delivers meals, serves communion, and prays with our homebound members.

ministries.title: Prison Ministry
ministries.description: Sharing the hope, forgiveness, and restorative grace of the Gospel with incarcerated men and women. We lead Bible studies inside local facilities and support families affected by incarceration.
